text: Welcome to Orchestra for Sucafina. In this walkthrough, we will prepare a regional operating review, from understanding the business to reviewing a proposed purchase. You will see the actual workspace: the navigation, the business records, and the review steps. We will also explore the A I layer. You will meet the resident profiles, inspect the skills they can use, and see how an analysis is tied to an authorized business case. Then we will explain Human Guardrail Claw and where it fits. We will move at a practical pace: what you click, why it matters, and what to check before taking the next step.
